title: Akiyama Mizuki — Brand New Style〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure I'd be able to wake up if I slept, which was why I basically ended up pulling an all-nighter...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What if I fall asleep while standing during the opening ceremony...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(How embarrassing would that be...?
If they line us up by the roll call order, I'm pretty much guaranteed to be in the front.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Man, I really won't wanna be chewed out for anything like that. Maybe I shouldn't go...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Being in different classes doesn't really change anything, you know? I mean, we'll still be friends.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Mizuki, I'm looking forward to us being second-years!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (We don't have classes today, so I guess I should at least attend the opening ceremony...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also, I should actually go see which class they put me in.)
You're right! What do you wanna do? Should we try saying something?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Yikes, we totally made eye contact just now...)

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student B
rows.Line:
H-Hold on...!
Why'd you start with that?!

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student B
rows.Line: Sorry! We initially thought you were someone from our old school, but then we noticed how cute your hair and ribbon were!

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student A
rows.Line:
I'm sorry for scaring you like that.
I chose to come to Kamiyama High because I thought these uniforms were really cute, but I'm having trouble getting my look down.

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student B
rows.Line: It's hard to customize or turn it into a real outfit since the teachers might start keeping an eye on you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Which is where I come in. Despite having done nothing all that special to my uniform, in your eyes, I've managed to achieve a unique look?

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student A
rows.Line: Yeah! I know we literally just met, but we'd love to hear any advice you have to give.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (They really just want advice about their uniforms because they thought I looked cute...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay! Then, I'll give you some tips that first-years like yourselves should have no problem employing!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, the light turned green. We're headed towards the same destination, so let's walk while we talk.

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student A
rows.Line:
Whaaat?! You're our senior?!
We're so sorry, Akiyama! We had no idea...!

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student B
rows.Line: Oh my gosh! I'm really, really, really sorry!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha! That's totally fine.
I don't really care about that kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Seriously, it's okay.
After all, I'm a friend of those who likes cute things♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: More importantly, you two should take my advice and come up with some cute looks for yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Based on what I've heard so far, you both have an eye for fashion. So, I hope you get to make the most of your Kamiyama High uniforms.

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student B
rows.Line:
Thank you very much!
We promise to find that cute look we're after!

rows.Speaker: Kamiyama High Student A
rows.Line: Thank you! I hope we get to talk again soon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It sounded like they were both really into fashion...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I like chatting with people like them. They're usually fun to be around.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (But they'll probably start hearing those rumors about me soon...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, whatever! Time to see who's in my new class♪
